translations.text: Which sentence uses the correct tense?
She will goes to the park.
She will go to the park.
Which sentence correctly uses a conjunction?
He went to the store, and he bought milk.
He went to the store, but he bought milk.
He went to the store, or he bought milk.
He went to the store, so he bought milk.
Identify the sentence with the correct use of a conditional.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it will rain, we will stay at home.
If it rained, we will stay at home.
If it rained, we would stay at home.
Identify the figure of speech in the sentence: 'The world is a stage.'
Which number should come next in the pattern: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?
या क्रमात पुढचा अंक कोणता येईल: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?
If it rains, the ground gets wet. The ground is wet. Did it rain?
पाऊस पडल्यास जमीन ओली होते. जमीन ओली आहे. पाऊस पडला का?
All humans are mortal. John is a human. Therefore, John is mortal. Is this correct?
सर्व माणसे नश्वर आहेत. जॉन माणूस आहे. म्हणून जॉन नश्वर आहे. हे बरोबर आहे का?
